name: design-review
title_zh: 对刚做完的界面做一次结构化设计评审
tagline_zh: 代码写完了但心里没底？让 skill 对照 brief 逐项检查视觉层级、一致性、响应式、无障碍和还原度。
tagline_en: Finished building but unsure? This skill audits your UI against the brief—visual hierarchy, consistency.
desc_en: Run a structured design critique against the brief and codebase. Checks visual hierarchy, consistency, responsiveness, accessibility, and aesthetic fidelity. Use when user wants a design review, critique, QA pass, polish pass, or mentions "review" after building.
why_zh: 不是泛泛而谈的审美建议，而是把设计原则拆成可执行的检查项，直接对照代码库逐条验证。
why_en: Not vague aesthetic opinions—it decomposes design principles into executable checks, validates them against your actual.
limit_zh: 只评审已有代码，不生成新设计；需要项目里有可读的样式文件和 brief 文本；对纯视觉稿（无代码）无效。
limit_en: Reviews existing code only, no new design generation. Needs readable style files and a brief in the repo. Useless for static mockups; ignores.
